summary: Modern SaaS landing page for NextHire AI (AI Resume Builder) with hero, features, how it works, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, and email signup sections. Blue and white color theme with clean, minimal, professional startup aesthetic.
architectural_notes: Blue and white color theme throughout
Modern SaaS startup landing page structure
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Modern abstract hero background illustration with blue gradients and geometric shapes (hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
- Icon representing AI resume builder - robot with document (icon-resume-builder.dim_128x128.png)
- Icon representing ATS checker - checkmark with document scan (icon-ats-checker.dim_128x128.png)
- Icon representing job tracker - briefcase with list (icon-job-tracker.dim_128x128.png)
- Professional headshot placeholder for testimonial 1 - business professional smiling (testimonial-1.dim_200x200.png)
- Professional headshot placeholder for testimonial 2 - business professional smiling (testimonial-2.dim_200x200.png)
- Professional headshot placeholder for testimonial 3 - business professional smiling (testimonial-3.dim_200x200.png)

existing_features.title: Create a hero section with a strong headline promoting NextHire AI as an AI-powered resume builder, a compelling subheadline, and a primary call-to-action button
Create a features section showcasing three key capabilities: AI resume builder, ATS checker, and job tracker, each with an icon, title, and description
Create a 'How it works' section explaining the user journey in 3-4 steps with visual hierarchy
Create a pricing section with at least three pricing tiers (e.g., Free, Pro, Enterprise) including features list and CTA buttons for each tier
Create a testimonials section with at least three customer testimonials, each including a quote, customer name, and role/company
Create an FAQ section with at least 5-6 common questions and answers in an expandable/collapsible format
Create a call-to-action section with email signup form that captures user email addresses and includes a submit button
Apply a blue and white color theme throughout the landing page with clean, minimal, and professional styling that reflects a modern startup aesthetic
Render generated images as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated for any visual elements created for the landing page
